what: First new object added to the 2.9.2 object database: asteroid Bennu from NASA's 3D Resources, converted by tools/make_object.py into a single-mesh .Gob and a .Sco, and placed 776 km out in Crucible with a mining settlement and a navigation waypoint

source.contents: glTF 2.0 from ImageToStl.com: one primitive, 9,122 vertices, 18,240 triangles, normals, no texture coordinates or images, flat material colour; normals point inward
source.credit: NASA (NASA 3D Resources); NASA media guidelines: generally not subject to US copyright, credit NASA, no implied endorsement

converted.template: Astr-C.Gob / Astr-C.Sco from the user's AOAOBJECTS.ODB
converted.checks: winding flipped by signed volume; all 18,240 faces and 9,880 vertex normals outward; Gob parses back with tools/gob2obj.py; face edge-length order |ab|,|bc|,|ca| matches all 518 Astr-C faces

tests: tools/test_make_object.py 7 passed (synthetic glTF, winding, triplanar UVs, mesh block, synthetic archive append, real template Gob/Sco, Bennu build); tools/test_make_map.py 12 passed; aoapack.rebuild with no changes reproduces the shipped AOAOBJECTS.ODB byte for byte and the 337 original entries decode unchanged after the append

live.client: play copy work/custom-map/client (patch_version 21), loopback relay as JRMAP with --map-waypoints, --powerup-zones and --sustained-delivery

runs.result: no crash; 103 = 82 earlier + 20 new models (Bennu included) + 1 safe zone; waypoints 'Far Yards' (slot 90) and 'Bennu' (slot 91) loaded as kind-3 world objects; F5 shows Bennu's lit surface with the docks, haulers, safe-zone box and an ore chunk; target windows list Bennu and Far Yards
F5 from about 220 km shows the whole of Bennu textured, the settlement on its face, ore chunks and the Bennu waypoint marker

not_verified: frame rate cost of the 18,240-triangle mesh (the captures were taken by automation, not timed)
